export interface StripeInvoiceFinalizedPayload {
  id: string;
  customer: {
    email: string;
  };
  lines: {
    data: Array<{
      description: string;
      amount: number;
      currency: string;
    }>;
    has_more?: boolean;
    url?: string;
  };
  url: string;
}

export interface ConnectorConfig {
  realmId: string;
  accessToken: string;
  serviceItemId?: string;
  customFieldDefinitionId?: string;
  defaultCustomerId: string;
  fetch?: typeof fetch;
}

export interface HandleResult {
  invoiceId: string;
  attachmentId: string;
}

function base64Encode(str: string): string {
  if (typeof Buffer !== 'undefined') {
    return Buffer.from(str).toString('base64');
  }
  // Fallback for browser-like environments (not expected in patchbay)
  return btoa(str);
}

async function fetchAllStripeLines(
  payload: StripeInvoiceFinalizedPayload,
  fetchFn: typeof fetch
): Promise<StripeInvoiceFinalizedPayload['lines']['data']> {
  const lines = payload.lines.data;
  if (payload.lines.has_more && payload.lines.url) {
    throw new Error(
      'Stripe invoice lines pagination detected (has_more=true) but connector cannot fetch additional pages without Stripe API credentials. Provide a Stripe secret key or ensure webhook delivers all lines.'
    );
  }
  return lines;
}

export async function handle(
  payload: StripeInvoiceFinalizedPayload,
  config: ConnectorConfig
): Promise<HandleResult> {
  const fetchFn = config.fetch ?? fetch;

  // Validate required fields
  if (!payload.id) throw new Error('Missing required field: id');
  if (!payload.customer?.email) throw new Error('Missing required field: customer.email');
  if (!payload.lines?.data || !Array.isArray(payload.lines.data) || payload.lines.data.length === 0) {
    throw new Error('Missing required field: lines.data (must be non-empty array)');
  }
  if (!payload.url) throw new Error('Missing required field: url');

  const allLines = await fetchAllStripeLines(payload, fetchFn);

  // Convert lines to QuickBooks format
  const qbLines = allLines.map((line) => ({
    Description: line.description,
    Amount: line.amount / 100,
    DetailType: 'SalesItemLineDetail',
    SalesItemLineDetail: {
      ItemRef: {
        value: config.serviceItemId ?? '1',
        name: 'Service',
      },
    },
  }));

  // Determine currency from first line (assume all lines same currency)
  const currency = allLines[0].currency.toUpperCase();

  // Build invoice request body
  const invoiceBody = {
    DocNumber: payload.id,
    Line: qbLines,
    Currency: currency,
    CustomerRef: {
      value: config.defaultCustomerId,
    },
    CustomField: [
      {
        DefinitionId: config.customFieldDefinitionId ?? '1',
        StringValue: payload.url,
      },
    ],
  };

  const invoiceUrl = `https://quickbooks.api.intuit.com/v3/company/${config.realmId}/invoice`;
  const invoiceResponse = await fetchFn(invoiceUrl, {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: {
      Authorization: `Bearer ${config.accessToken}`,
      'Content-Type': 'application/json',
      Accept: 'application/json',
    },
    body: JSON.stringify(invoiceBody),
  });

  if (!invoiceResponse.ok) {
    throw new Error(
      `QuickBooks create invoice failed: ${invoiceResponse.status} ${invoiceResponse.statusText} at ${invoiceUrl}`
    );
  }

  const invoiceJson = await invoiceResponse.json();
  const invoiceId = invoiceJson?.Invoice?.Id;
  if (!invoiceId) throw new Error('QuickBooks invoice response missing Invoice.Id');

  // Attach Stripe invoice URL as document
  const attachmentBody = {
    AttachableRef: [
      {
        EntityRef: {
          type: 'Invoice',
          value: invoiceId,
        },
      },
    ],
    FileName: 'stripe_invoice.txt',
    ContentType: 'text/plain',
    ByteOrder: 'LittleEndian',
    Content: base64Encode(payload.url),
  };

  const attachmentUrl = `https://quickbooks.api.intuit.com/v3/company/${config.realmId}/attachment`;
  const attachmentResponse = await fetchFn(attachmentUrl, {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: {
      Authorization: `Bearer ${config.accessToken}`,
      'Content-Type': 'application/json',
      Accept: 'application/json',
    },
    body: JSON.stringify(attachmentBody),
  });

  if (!attachmentResponse.ok) {
    throw new Error(
      `QuickBooks attach document failed: ${attachmentResponse.status} ${attachmentResponse.statusText} at ${attachmentUrl}`
    );
  }

  const attachmentJson = await attachmentResponse.json();
  const attachmentId = attachmentJson?.Attachment?.Id;
  if (!attachmentId) throw new Error('QuickBooks attachment response missing Attachment.Id');

  return { invoiceId, attachmentId };
}

# Stripe Invoice to QuickBooks Connector

This connector listens for Stripe `invoice.finalized` webhooks, creates a corresponding invoice in QuickBooks Online with line items, and attaches the Stripe invoice URL as a document to the QuickBooks invoice.

## What it does

1. Receives a Stripe `invoice.finalized` webhook payload.
2. Validates required fields (invoice ID, customer email, line items, hosted invoice URL).
3. Converts Stripe line items (amounts in cents, currency codes) to QuickBooks format (decimal amounts, ISO 4217 currency).
4. Creates a QuickBooks invoice via the QuickBooks Online API (`POST /v3/company/<realmID>/invoice`).
5. Attaches the Stripe invoice URL as a base64-encoded text file to the created invoice via the QuickBooks Attachment endpoint (`POST /v3/company/<realmID>/attachment`).
6. Returns the created QuickBooks invoice ID and attachment ID.

## Configuration / Environment Variables

| Config Property | Environment Variable | Required | Description |
|-----------------|----------------------|----------|-------------|
| `realmId` | `QUICKBOOKS_REALM_ID` | Yes | QuickBooks company realm ID (used in API base URL). |
| `accessToken` | `QUICKBOOKS_OAUTH_ACCESS_TOKEN` | Yes | OAuth 2.0 Bearer token for QuickBooks API authentication. |
| `defaultCustomerId` | `QUICKBOOKS_DEFAULT_CUSTOMER_ID` | Yes | QuickBooks Customer ID to use for `CustomerRef` (the connector cannot look up customers by email). |
| `serviceItemId` | `QUICKBOOKS_SERVICE_ITEM_ID` | No (default: `"1"`) | QuickBooks Item ID for the default service item used in line items. |
| `customFieldDefinitionId` | `QUICKBOOKS_STRIPE_URL_CUSTOM_FIELD_DEFINITION_ID` | No (default: `"1"`) | QuickBooks Custom Field Definition ID for the "Stripe Invoice URL" field. |

All secrets must be provided via the config object at runtime. The connector never reads `process.env` directly.

## Usage Example

```typescript
import { handle, ConnectorConfig } from './connector';

const config: ConnectorConfig = {
  realmId: process.env.QUICKBOOKS_REALM_ID!,
  accessToken: process.env.QUICKBOOKS_OAUTH_ACCESS_TOKEN!,
  defaultCustomerId: process.env.QUICKBOOKS_DEFAULT_CUSTOMER_ID!,
  // optional overrides:
  // serviceItemId: process.env.QUICKBOOKS_SERVICE_ITEM_ID,
  // customFieldDefinitionId: process.env.QUICKBOOKS_STRIPE_URL_CUSTOM_FIELD_DEFINITION_ID,
};

const stripeWebhookPayload = {
  id: 'in_1NpHiG2eZvKYlo2CZV0ZkEBT',
  customer: { email: 'jennyrosen@example.com' },
  lines: {
    data: [
      { description: 'My First Invoice Item (created for API docs)', amount: 129999, currency: 'usd' }
    ]
  },
  url: 'https://pay.stripe.com/invoice/in_1NpHiG2eZvKYlo2CZV0ZkEBT'
};

const result = await handle(stripeWebhookPayload, config);
console.log('Created QuickBooks invoice:', result.invoiceId);
console.log('Attached document:', result.attachmentId);
```

## Assumptions & Limitations

- The Stripe webhook is already configured and delivers `invoice.finalized` events with the full invoice object including `lines.data`.
- The QuickBooks company file exists and the integration has OAuth access with write permissions.
- Each Stripe invoice line maps directly to a QuickBooks line item without additional transformation (quantity, tax, etc. are not handled).
- QuickBooks supports attaching a URL as a custom field (DefinitionId) and as a document attachment. The connector uses a default service item (ItemRef value `"1"`) and a default custom field (DefinitionId `"1"`). Override via config if your setup differs.
- The connector uses the `defaultCustomerId` config for `CustomerRef` because it cannot query QuickBooks for a customer by email. You must map Stripe customers to QuickBooks customers externally and provide the ID.
- Stripe line item pagination (`has_more: true`) is not supported because the connector lacks Stripe API credentials. If the webhook payload contains `has_more: true`, the connector throws an error. Ensure your webhook delivers all lines or enhance the connector with a Stripe secret key.
- Amounts are converted from cents to decimal dollars (divide by 100).
- Currency codes are uppercased to match ISO 4217 (e.g., `usd` → `USD`).
- The attachment stores the Stripe invoice URL as a base64-encoded plain text file named `stripe_invoice.txt`.

export function fakeFetch(

): { fetch: typeof fetch; calls: RecordedCall[] } {
  const calls: RecordedCall[] = []
  const fake = async (input: string | URL | Request, init: RequestInit = {}): Promise<Response> => {
    const url = input instanceof Request ? input.url : String(input)
    const method = (init.method ?? (input instanceof Request ? input.method : 'GET')).toUpperCase()
    const body = typeof init.body === 'string' ? init.body : init.body == null ? undefined : String(init.body)
    const call: RecordedCall = { method, url, body, json: parseJson(body), headers: new Headers(init.headers) }
    calls.push(call)
    return handler(call)
  }
  return { fetch: fake as typeof fetch, calls }

const STATUS_TEXT: Record<number, string> = {
  200: 'OK', 201: 'Created', 202: 'Accepted', 204: 'No Content',
  400: 'Bad Request', 401: 'Unauthorized', 403: 'Forbidden', 404: 'Not Found', 409: 'Conflict',
  422: 'Unprocessable Entity', 429: 'Too Many Requests',
  500: 'Internal Server Error', 502: 'Bad Gateway', 503: 'Service Unavailable',
}

/** A JSON Response with the standard status text, e.g. jsonResponse({ error: 'nope' }, 401) -> "401 Unauthorized". */
export function jsonResponse(body: unknown, status = 200): Response {
  const init = { status, statusText: STATUS_TEXT[status] ?? '', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } }
  return new Response(status === 204 ? null : JSON.stringify(body), init)
}

function parseJson(raw: string | undefined): unknown {
  if (raw === undefined) return undefined
  try {
    return JSON.parse(raw)
  } catch {
    return undefined
  }
}

function urlMatches(template: string, actual: string): boolean {
  const t = splitUrl(template)
  const a = splitUrl(actual)
  if (!t || !a) return false
  const tHost = t.host.split('.')
  const aHost = a.host.split('.')
  if (tHost.slice(-2).join('.') !== aHost.slice(-2).join('.')) return false
  const tPath = t.path.replace(/\/+$/, '').split('/')
  const aPath = a.path.replace(/\/+$/, '').split('/')
  if (tPath.length !== aPath.length) return false
  return tPath.every((segment, i) => isPlaceholder(segment) || segment === aPath[i])
}

function splitUrl(url: string): { host: string; path: string } | null {
  const match = url.match(/^https?:\/\/([^/?#]+)([^?#]*)/i)
  return match ? { host: (match[1] ?? '').toLowerCase(), path: match[2] || '/' } : null
}

function isPlaceholder(segment: string): boolean {
  return /^\{[^}]+\}$|^:[A-Za-z_]\w*$|^<[^>]+>$/.test(segment)
}

  if (!payload || typeof payload !== 'object') {
    throw new Error('Invalid payload: expected an object')
  }
  const p = payload as Record<string, unknown>
  if (typeof p.Body !== 'string' || p.Body.trim() === '') {
    throw new Error('Missing required field: Body')
  }
  if (typeof p.From !== 'string' || p.From.trim() === '') {
    throw new Error('Missing required field: From')
  }
  return {
    Body: p.Body,
    From: p.From,
    To: typeof p.To === 'string' ? p.To : '',
  }
}

function determineChannel(body: string): string {
  return SALES_KEYWORDS.test(body) ? '#sales' : '#support'
}

async function sendSlackMessage(
  config: ConnectorConfig,
  channel: string,
  text: string,
): Promise<SlackMessageResult> {
  const fetchFn = config.fetch ?? fetch
  const url = 'https://slack.com/api/chat.postMessage'
  const body = JSON.stringify({ channel, text })
  const response = await fetchFn(url, {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: {
      'Content-Type': 'application/json',
      Authorization: `Bearer ${config.slackBotToken}`,
    },
    body,
  })
  if (!response.ok) {
    throw new Error(`Slack API error: ${response.status} ${response.statusText} at ${url}`)
  }
  return (await response.json()) as SlackMessageResult
}

export async function handle(
  payload: unknown,
  config: ConnectorConfig,
): Promise<HandleResult> {
  if (!config.slackBotToken) {
    throw new Error('Missing required config: slackBotToken')
  }
  const validated = validatePayload(payload)
  const channel = determineChannel(validated.Body)
  const slackResponse = await sendSlackMessage(config, channel, validated.Body)
  return { channel, slackResponse }
}

# Twilio SMS to Slack Connector

Routes incoming Twilio SMS webhooks to Slack channels based on message content.

## What it does

When a Twilio incoming SMS webhook arrives, this connector:
1. Parses the form-encoded payload (Body, From, To)
2. Checks if the message body matches `/pricing|quote|demo/i` (case-insensitive)
3. Routes to `#sales` if matched, otherwise to `#support`
4. Sends the message to the determined Slack channel via `chat.postMessage`

## Configuration

| Config Property | Environment Variable | Required | Description |
|-----------------|---------------------|----------|-------------|
| `slackBotToken` | `SLACK_BOT_TOKEN` | Yes | Slack bot token (xoxb-...) for posting messages |

## Usage Example

```typescript
import { handle } from './connector'

// In your webhook handler (e.g., Express, Fastify, Cloudflare Workers)
app.post('/twilio-webhook', async (req, res) => {
  try {
    // Twilio sends application/x-www-form-urlencoded
    const formBody = req.body // already parsed by body-parser or similar
    const result = await handle(formBody, {
      slackBotToken: process.env.SLACK_BOT_TOKEN,
    })
    res.json({ success: true, channel: result.channel })
  } catch (err) {
    console.error(err)
    res.status(500).json({ error: err.message })
  }
})
```

## Assumptions

- The Twilio webhook payload includes `Body`, `From`, and `To` fields as documented.
- Slack bot token is configured with permissions to post to both `#sales` and `#support` channels.
- The regex pattern `/pricing|quote|demo/i` is evaluated case-insensitively on the message body.
- Only one Slack message send action is performed per webhook invocation based on the routing decision.
- Signature validation for Twilio webhooks is recommended but not implemented in this connector.
- The connector expects the incoming request body to already be parsed from `application/x-www-form-urlencoded` format.

function urlMatches(template: string, actual: string): boolean {
  const t = splitUrl(template)

  const tHost = t.host.split('.')
  const aHost = a.host.split('.')
  if (tHost.slice(-2).join('.') !== aHost.slice(-2).join('.')) return false
  const tPath = t.path.replace(/\/+$/, '').split('/')
  const aPath = a.path.replace(/\/+$/, '').split('/')
  if (tPath.length !== aPath.length) return false
  return tPath.every((segment, i) => isPlaceholder(segment) || segment === aPath[i])
}

function splitUrl(url: string): { host: string; path: string } | null {
  const match = url.match(/^https?:\/\/([^/?#]+)([^?#]*)/i)
  return match ? { host: (match[1] ?? '').toLowerCase(), path: match[2] || '/' } : null
}

function isPlaceholder(segment: string): boolean {
  return /^\{[^}]+\}$|^:[A-Za-z_]\w*$|^<[^>]+>$/.test(segment)

import crypto from 'node:crypto'

export interface ConnectorConfig {
  githubWebhookSecret: string
  linearApiKey: string
  linearTeamId: string
  linearBugLabelId: string
  fetch?: typeof fetch
  /** Raw request body for HMAC signature verification (optional, per-request) */
  rawBody?: string
  /** Value of the X-Hub-Signature-256 header (optional, per-request) */
  signatureHeader?: string
}

export interface GitHubIssuePayload {
  action: string
  issue: {
    title: string
    body: string | null
    user: {
      login: string
    }
    labels: Array<{
      name: string
    }>
    html_url: string
  }
  repository: {
    full_name: string
  }
}

export interface LinearIssueResult {
  id: string
  identifier: string
  title: string
  description: string
  url: string
  createdAt: string
  updatedAt: string
}

export interface HandleResult {
  linearIssueId: string
  linearIssueIdentifier: string
  linearIssueUrl: string
}

async function verifySignature(
  payload: string,
  signatureHeader: string | null,
  secret: string
): Promise<void> {
  if (!signatureHeader) {
    throw new Error('Missing X-Hub-Signature-256 header')
  }
  const expected = 'sha256=' + crypto.createHmac('sha256', secret).update(payload).digest('hex')
  if (!crypto.timingSafeEqual(Buffer.from(signatureHeader), Buffer.from(expected))) {
    throw new Error('Invalid webhook signature')
  }
}

function hasBugLabel(labels: Array<{ name: string }>): boolean {
  return labels.some((label) => label.name.toLowerCase() === 'bug')
}

export async function handle(
  payload: GitHubIssuePayload,
  config: ConnectorConfig
): Promise<HandleResult> {
  const fetchImpl = config.fetch ?? fetch

  // Verify GitHub webhook signature if raw body and signature header are provided
  if (config.rawBody !== undefined && config.signatureHeader !== undefined) {
    await verifySignature(config.rawBody, config.signatureHeader, config.githubWebhookSecret)
  }

  if (!payload.action || (payload.action !== 'labeled' && payload.action !== 'opened')) {
    throw new Error(`Unsupported action: ${payload.action}. Only 'labeled' or 'opened' are processed.`)
  }

  if (!payload.issue) {
    throw new Error('Missing issue object in payload')
  }

  const { title, body, user, labels, html_url } = payload.issue

  if (!title) {
    throw new Error('Missing required field: issue.title')
  }
  if (!user?.login) {
    throw new Error('Missing required field: issue.user.login')
  }
  if (!html_url) {
    throw new Error('Missing required field: issue.html_url')
  }
  if (!labels || !hasBugLabel(labels)) {
    throw new Error('Issue does not have the "bug" label')
  }

  const mutation = `
    mutation IssueCreate($input: IssueCreateInput!) {
      issueCreate(input: $input) {
        success
        issue {
          id
          identifier
          title
          description
          url
          createdAt
          updatedAt
        }
      }
    }
  `

  const variables = {
    input: {
      title,
      description: body ?? '',
      teamId: config.linearTeamId,
      labelIds: [config.linearBugLabelId],
    },
  }

  const response = await fetchImpl('https://api.linear.app/graphql', {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: {
      'Content-Type': 'application/json',
      Authorization: `Bearer ${config.linearApiKey}`,
    },
    body: JSON.stringify({ query: mutation, variables }),
  })

  if (!response.ok) {
    throw new Error(`Linear API error: ${response.status} ${response.statusText} at POST https://api.linear.app/graphql`)
  }

  const data = (await response.json()) as {
    data?: {
      issueCreate?: {
        success: boolean
        issue?: LinearIssueResult
      }
    }
    errors?: Array<{ message: string }>
  }

  if (data.errors?.length) {
    throw new Error(`Linear GraphQL errors: ${data.errors.map((e) => e.message).join(', ')}`)
  }

  const issue = data.data?.issueCreate?.issue
  if (!issue || !data.data?.issueCreate?.success) {
    throw new Error('Linear issue creation failed: no issue returned')
  }

  return {
    linearIssueId: issue.id,
    linearIssueIdentifier: issue.identifier,
    linearIssueUrl: issue.url,
  }
}

# GitHub Bug Label → Linear Triage Issue Connector

This connector listens for GitHub webhook events when an issue is labeled **'bug'** and creates a corresponding issue in the Linear **Triage** team.

## What it does

1. Receives a GitHub `issues` webhook with action `labeled` or `opened`
2. Verifies the HMAC-SHA256 signature using the webhook secret
3. Confirms the issue has the `bug` label
4. Maps GitHub issue fields to Linear's GraphQL `IssueCreate` mutation
5. Creates the issue in the configured Linear Triage team
6. Returns the created Linear issue's ID, identifier, and URL

## Configuration

All secrets and IDs are provided via the `ConnectorConfig` object (typically sourced from environment variables):

| Config Property | Environment Variable | Description |
|-----------------|---------------------|-------------|
| `githubWebhookSecret` | `GITHUB_WEBHOOK_SECRET` | GitHub webhook secret for HMAC-SHA256 signature verification |
| `linearApiKey` | `LINEAR_API_KEY` | Linear API Bearer token |
| `linearTeamId` | `LINEAR_TRIAGE_TEAM_ID` | UUID of the Linear Triage team |
| `linearBugLabelId` | `LINEAR_BUG_LABEL_ID` | UUID of the Linear label that corresponds to GitHub's `bug` label |
| `rawBody` | (per-request) | Raw request body string for signature verification |
| `signatureHeader` | (per-request) | Value of the `X-Hub-Signature-256` header for signature verification |

## Usage Example

```typescript
import { handle, GitHubIssuePayload, ConnectorConfig } from './connector'

const config: ConnectorConfig = {
  githubWebhookSecret: process.env.GITHUB_WEBHOOK_SECRET!,
  linearApiKey: process.env.LINEAR_API_KEY!,
  linearTeamId: process.env.LINEAR_TRIAGE_TEAM_ID!,
  linearBugLabelId: process.env.LINEAR_BUG_LABEL_ID!,
}

// In your webhook handler (e.g., Express, Fastify, Cloudflare Worker):
app.post('/github-webhook', async (req, res) => {
  const payload = req.body as GitHubIssuePayload
  const rawBody = JSON.stringify(req.body) // or use raw body from middleware
  const signature = req.headers['x-hub-signature-256'] as string

  try {
    const result = await handle(payload, { ...config, rawBody, signatureHeader: signature })
    res.json({ success: true, ...result })
  } catch (err) {
    res.status(400).json({ error: err.message })
  }
})
```

## Field Mapping

| GitHub Field | Linear Field | Notes |
|--------------|--------------|-------|
| `issue.title` | `title` | Required |
| `issue.body` | `description` | Empty string if null |
| `issue.user.login` | (not directly mapped) | Used for reference; Linear assignee mapping would require a user directory sync |
| `issue.labels` (filter `bug`) | `labelIds` | Mapped to configured `linearBugLabelId` |
| `issue.html_url` | `url` | Stored in Linear issue's `url` field |

## Assumptions

1. **GitHub webhook payload** includes the full issue object under the `issue` key when the event is `issues` and action is `labeled` or `opened`.
2. **Linear API** requires a team identifier (`teamId`); the integration defaults to the Triage team via `linearTeamId` config.
3. **Linear labels** are mapped from GitHub labels; the `bug` label maps to a specific Linear label UUID (`linearBugLabelId`).
4. **Permissions**: The Linear API key has permission to create issues in the Triage team. The GitHub webhook is configured to deliver `issues` events.
5. **Idempotency**: The `X-GitHub-Delivery` header can be used by the consumer to deduplicate deliveries (not handled by this connector).
6. **Response time**: The webhook must respond 2xx within 10 seconds; this connector is synchronous and fast.

## Error Handling

- **Invalid signature** → throws `Error('Invalid webhook signature')`
- **Missing signature header** → throws `Error('Missing X-Hub-Signature-256 header')`
- **Unsupported action** → throws descriptive error (only `labeled`/`opened` processed)
- **Missing required fields** (`title`, `user.login`, `html_url`) → throws descriptive error
- **Missing `bug` label** → throws `Error('Issue does not have the "bug" label')`
- **Linear API non-2xx** → throws with status code and endpoint
- **Linear GraphQL errors** → throws with error messages
- **Linear creation failure** → throws `Error('Linear issue creation failed: no issue returned')`

## Testing

Run tests with Vitest:

```bash
vitest run src/connector.test.ts
```

Tests cover:
- Contract test with documented example payload
- Happy path with exact GraphQL request body
- Signature verification
- Field mapping validation
- Missing required fields
- Non-2xx Linear responses
- GraphQL error responses
- Action filtering

export interface RecordedCall {
  method: string
  url: string

  body: string | undefined

  json: unknown

/** The documented endpoint a request matches, placeholders and region subdomains included. */
export function findEndpoint(method: string, url: string): DocumentedEndpoint | undefined {
  return TARGET_ENDPOINTS.find((endpoint) => endpoint.method === method.toUpperCase() && urlMatches(endpoint.url, url))
}

/**
 * A fake fetch that answers every documented endpoint with its documented response and
 * rejects anything else. Use it in the contract test:
 *
 *   const { fetch, calls } = contractFetch()
 *   await handle(SOURCE_EXAMPLE as MyInput, { ...config, fetch })
 *   expect(calls.length).toBeGreaterThan(0)
 */
export function contractFetch(): { fetch: typeof fetch; calls: RecordedCall[] } {
  return fakeFetch((request) => {
    const endpoint = findEndpoint(request.method, request.url)
    if (!endpoint) throw new Error(`contract: ${request.method} ${request.url} is not a documented endpoint`)
    return jsonResponse(endpoint.response)
  })
}

/**
 * A correctly typed fake fetch for every other test. The handler receives the recorded
 * request: { method, url, body (string as sent), json (parsed body), headers (Headers) }.
 *
 *   const { fetch, calls } = fakeFetch((req) => req.url.endsWith('/deals') ? jsonResponse({ id: 1 }, 201) : jsonResponse({}, 404))
 */
export function fakeFetch(
  handler: (request: RecordedCall) => Response | Promise<Response>,
): { fetch: typeof fetch; calls: RecordedCall[] } {
  const calls: RecordedCall[] = []
  const fake = async (input: string | URL | Request, init: RequestInit = {}): Promise<Response> => {
    const url = input instanceof Request ? input.url : String(input)
    const method = (init.method ?? (input instanceof Request ? input.method : 'GET')).toUpperCase()
    const body = typeof init.body === 'string' ? init.body : init.body == null ? undefined : String(init.body)
    const call: RecordedCall = { method, url, body, json: parseJson(body), headers: new Headers(init.headers) }
    calls.push(call)
    return handler(call)
  }
  return { fetch: fake as typeof fetch, calls }
}

const STATUS_TEXT: Record<number, string> = {
  200: 'OK', 201: 'Created', 202: 'Accepted', 204: 'No Content',
  400: 'Bad Request', 401: 'Unauthorized', 403: 'Forbidden', 404: 'Not Found', 409: 'Conflict',
  422: 'Unprocessable Entity', 429: 'Too Many Requests',
  500: 'Internal Server Error', 502: 'Bad Gateway', 503: 'Service Unavailable',
}

/** A JSON Response with the standard status text, e.g. jsonResponse({ error: 'nope' }, 401) -> "401 Unauthorized". */
export function jsonResponse(body: unknown, status = 200): Response {
  const init = { status, statusText: STATUS_TEXT[status] ?? '', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } }
  return new Response(status === 204 ? null : JSON.stringify(body), init)
}

function parseJson(raw: string | undefined): unknown {
  if (raw === undefined) return undefined
  try {
    return JSON.parse(raw)
  } catch {
    return undefined
  }
}

function urlMatches(template: string, actual: string): boolean {
  const t = splitUrl(template)
  const a = splitUrl(actual)
  if (!t || !a) return false
  const tHost = t.host.split('.')
  const aHost = a.host.split('.')
  if (tHost.slice(-2).join('.') !== aHost.slice(-2).join('.')) return false
  const tPath = t.path.replace(/\/+$/, '').split('/')
  const aPath = a.path.replace(/\/+$/, '').split('/')
  if (tPath.length !== aPath.length) return false
  return tPath.every((segment, i) => isPlaceholder(segment) || segment === aPath[i])
}

function splitUrl(url: string): { host: string; path: string } | null {
  const match = url.match(/^https?:\/\/([^/?#]+)([^?#]*)/i)
  return match ? { host: (match[1] ?? '').toLowerCase(), path: match[2] || '/' } : null
}

function isPlaceholder(segment: string): boolean {
  return /^\{[^}]+\}$|^:[A-Za-z_]\w*$|^<[^>]+>$/.test(segment)
}

export interface ConnectorConfig {
  companyDomain: string;
  apiToken: string;
  fetch?: FetchFn;
  fieldMapping?: {
    nameFieldId?: string;
    emailFieldId?: string;
    companyFieldId?: string;
    phoneFieldId?: string;
    dealAmountFieldId?: string;
    dealTitleFieldId?: string;
  };
}

export type FetchFn = (input: RequestInfo | URL, init?: RequestInit) => Promise<Response>;

export interface TypeformWebhookPayload {
  event_id: string;
  event_type: string;
  form_response: {
    form_id: string;
    token: string;
    submitted_at: string;
    answers: Array<{
      type: string;
      text?: string;
      email?: string;
      number?: number;
      date?: string;
      field: {
        id: string;
        type: string;
      };
    }>;
    hidden: Record<string, unknown>;
  };
}

export interface HandleResult {
  organizationId: number;
  personId: number;
  dealId: number;
}

function getAnswerValue(
  answers: TypeformWebhookPayload['form_response']['answers'],
  fieldId: string,
): string | number | undefined {
  const answer = answers.find((a) => a.field.id === fieldId);
  if (!answer) return undefined;
  if (answer.type === 'text' || answer.type === 'email') return answer.text ?? answer.email;
  if (answer.type === 'number') return answer.number;
  return answer.text;
}

function buildUrl(base: string, companyDomain: string, apiToken: string): string {
  return base
    .replace('{company_domain}', companyDomain)
    .replace('{api_token}', apiToken);
}

async function postJson<T>(
  fetchImpl: FetchFn,
  url: string,
  body: unknown,
): Promise<T> {
  const response = await fetchImpl(url, {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
    body: JSON.stringify(body),
  });
  if (!response.ok) {
    throw new Error(`Pipedrive API error: ${response.status} ${response.statusText} for ${url}`);
  }
  return response.json() as Promise<T>;
}

export async function handle(
  payload: TypeformWebhookPayload,
  config: ConnectorConfig,
): Promise<HandleResult> {
  const fetchImpl = config.fetch ?? fetch;
  const {
    nameFieldId = 'JwWggjAKtOkA',
    emailFieldId = 'SMEUb7VJz92Q',
    companyFieldId = 'some_company_field',
    phoneFieldId,
    dealAmountFieldId = 'deal_amount_field',
    dealTitleFieldId = 'deal_title_field',
  } = config.fieldMapping ?? {};

  const answers = payload.form_response?.answers;
  if (!answers || !Array.isArray(answers)) {
    throw new Error('Invalid payload: missing form_response.answers');
  }

  const name = getAnswerValue(answers, nameFieldId) as string | undefined;
  const email = getAnswerValue(answers, emailFieldId) as string | undefined;
  const company = getAnswerValue(answers, companyFieldId) as string | undefined;
  const phone = phoneFieldId ? (getAnswerValue(answers, phoneFieldId) as string | undefined) : undefined;
  const dealAmount = getAnswerValue(answers, dealAmountFieldId) as number | undefined;
  const dealTitle = getAnswerValue(answers, dealTitleFieldId) as string | undefined;

  if (!name) throw new Error('Required field "name" not found in form answers');
  if (!email) throw new Error('Required field "email" not found in form answers');

  const orgName = company ?? name;

  const orgUrl = buildUrl(
    'https://{company_domain}.pipedrive.com/api/v2/organizations?api_token={api_token}',
    config.companyDomain,
    config.apiToken,
  );
  const orgResponse = await postJson<{ data: { id: number } }>(fetchImpl, orgUrl, { name: orgName });
  const organizationId = orgResponse.data.id;

  const personUrl = buildUrl(
    'https://{company_domain}.pipedrive.com/api/v2/persons?api_token={api_token}',
    config.companyDomain,
    config.apiToken,
  );
  const personBody: Record<string, unknown> = {
    name,
    email: [{ value: email, label: 'work' }],
  };
  if (phone) personBody.phone = [{ value: phone, label: 'work' }];
  if (organizationId) personBody.org_id = organizationId;

  const personResponse = await postJson<{ data: { id: number } }>(fetchImpl, personUrl, personBody);
  const personId = personResponse.data.id;

  if (!dealTitle) throw new Error('Required field "deal_title" not found in form answers');

  const dealUrl = buildUrl(
    'https://{company_domain}.pipedrive.com/api/v2/deals?api_token={api_token}',
    config.companyDomain,
    config.apiToken,
  );
  const dealBody: Record<string, unknown> = {
    title: dealTitle,
    org_id: organizationId,
    person_id: personId,
  };
  if (typeof dealAmount === 'number') dealBody.value = dealAmount;

  const dealResponse = await postJson<{ data: { id: number } }>(fetchImpl, dealUrl, dealBody);
  const dealId = dealResponse.data.id;

  return { organizationId, personId, dealId };
}

# Typeform to Pipedrive Connector

Creates an organization, person, and deal in Pipedrive when a Typeform contact form is submitted.

## What it does

1. Receives a Typeform webhook payload (form response)
2. Extracts form answers using configurable field IDs
3. Creates a Pipedrive organization (using company name or submitter name as fallback)
4. Creates a Pipedrive person linked to the organization
5. Creates a Pipedrive deal linked to both the organization and person

## Configuration

| Config Property | Environment Variable | Required | Description |
|-----------------|---------------------|----------|-------------|
| `companyDomain` | `PIPEDRIVE_COMPANY_DOMAIN` | Yes | Your Pipedrive company domain (e.g., `mydomain` for `mydomain.pipedrive.com`) |
| `apiToken` | `PIPEDRIVE_API_TOKEN` | Yes | Pipedrive API token for authentication |
| `fieldMapping.nameFieldId` | — | No | Typeform field ID for submitter name (default: `JwWggjAKtOkA`) |
| `fieldMapping.emailFieldId` | — | No | Typeform field ID for email (default: `SMEUb7VJz92Q`) |
| `fieldMapping.companyFieldId` | — | No | Typeform field ID for company name (default: `some_company_field`) |
| `fieldMapping.phoneFieldId` | — | No | Typeform field ID for phone number (optional) |
| `fieldMapping.dealAmountFieldId` | — | No | Typeform field ID for deal amount (default: `deal_amount_field`) |
| `fieldMapping.dealTitleFieldId` | — | No | Typeform field ID for deal title (default: `deal_title_field`) |

## Usage Example

```typescript
import { handle, ConnectorConfig } from './connector';

const config: ConnectorConfig = {
  companyDomain: process.env.PIPEDRIVE_COMPANY_DOMAIN!,
  apiToken: process.env.PIPEDRIVE_API_TOKEN!,
  fieldMapping: {
    // Optional: override if your form uses different field IDs
    phoneFieldId: 'my_phone_field_id',
  },
};

// In your webhook handler:
const result = await handle(typeformPayload, config);
console.log('Created:', result); // { organizationId, personId, dealId }
```

## Assumptions

- The Typeform includes fields for name, email, and optionally company and phone.
- The Pipedrive API uses the same field names for organization and person creation as documented in the official reference.
- If a deal amount is not provided, the deal is created without a value.
- The integration creates the organization first, then the person, then the deal, using IDs from prior steps.
- Field IDs in the Typeform form match the defaults or are provided via `fieldMapping` config.
- The webhook payload follows the documented Typeform structure with `form_response.answers` array.
- Pipedrive API token is passed as a query parameter (`api_token`) on all endpoints.

export interface RecordedCall {
  method: string
  url: string
  /** The request body exactly as sent (usually a JSON string). */
  body: string | undefined

  json: unknown
  headers: Headers

/** The documented endpoint a request matches, placeholders and region subdomains included. */
export function findEndpoint(method: string, url: string): DocumentedEndpoint | undefined {
  return TARGET_ENDPOINTS.find((endpoint) => endpoint.method === method.toUpperCase() && urlMatches(endpoint.url, url))
}

/**

 * rejects anything else. Use it in the contract test:

 *   const { fetch, calls } = contractFetch()
 *   await handle(SOURCE_EXAMPLE as MyInput, { ...config, fetch })
 *   expect(calls.length).toBeGreaterThan(0)
 */
export function contractFetch(): { fetch: typeof fetch; calls: RecordedCall[] } {
  return fakeFetch((request) => {
    const endpoint = findEndpoint(request.method, request.url)
    if (!endpoint) throw new Error(`contract: ${request.method} ${request.url} is not a documented endpoint`)
    return jsonResponse(endpoint.response)
  })
}

/**
 * A correctly typed fake fetch for every other test. The handler receives the recorded
 * request: { method, url, body (string as sent), json (parsed body), headers (Headers) }.
 *
 *   const { fetch, calls } = fakeFetch((req) => req.url.endsWith('/deals') ? jsonResponse({ id: 1 }, 201) : jsonResponse({}, 404))
 */
export function fakeFetch(
  handler: (request: RecordedCall) => Response | Promise<Response>,
): { fetch: typeof fetch; calls: RecordedCall[] } {
  const calls: RecordedCall[] = []
  const fake = async (input: string | URL | Request, init: RequestInit = {}): Promise<Response> => {
    const url = input instanceof Request ? input.url : String(input)
    const method = (init.method ?? (input instanceof Request ? input.method : 'GET')).toUpperCase()
    const body = typeof init.body === 'string' ? init.body : init.body == null ? undefined : String(init.body)
    const call: RecordedCall = { method, url, body, json: parseJson(body), headers: new Headers(init.headers) }
    calls.push(call)
    return handler(call)
  }
  return { fetch: fake as typeof fetch, calls }
}

const STATUS_TEXT: Record<number, string> = {
  200: 'OK', 201: 'Created', 202: 'Accepted', 204: 'No Content',
  400: 'Bad Request', 401: 'Unauthorized', 403: 'Forbidden', 404: 'Not Found', 409: 'Conflict',
  422: 'Unprocessable Entity', 429: 'Too Many Requests',
  500: 'Internal Server Error', 502: 'Bad Gateway', 503: 'Service Unavailable',
}

/** A JSON Response with the standard status text, e.g. jsonResponse({ error: 'nope' }, 401) -> "401 Unauthorized". */
export function jsonResponse(body: unknown, status = 200): Response {
  const init = { status, statusText: STATUS_TEXT[status] ?? '', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } }
  return new Response(status === 204 ? null : JSON.stringify(body), init)
}

function parseJson(raw: string | undefined): unknown {
  if (raw === undefined) return undefined
  try {
    return JSON.parse(raw)
  } catch {
    return undefined
  }
}

function urlMatches(template: string, actual: string): boolean {
  const t = splitUrl(template)
  const a = splitUrl(actual)
  if (!t || !a) return false
  const tHost = t.host.split('.')
  const aHost = a.host.split('.')
  if (tHost.slice(-2).join('.') !== aHost.slice(-2).join('.')) return false
  const tPath = t.path.replace(/\/+$/, '').split('/')
  const aPath = a.path.replace(/\/+$/, '').split('/')
  if (tPath.length !== aPath.length) return false
  return tPath.every((segment, i) => isPlaceholder(segment) || segment === aPath[i])
}

function splitUrl(url: string): { host: string; path: string } | null {
  const match = url.match(/^https?:\/\/([^/?#]+)([^?#]*)/i)
  return match ? { host: (match[1] ?? '').toLowerCase(), path: match[2] || '/' } : null
}

function isPlaceholder(segment: string): boolean {
  return /^\{[^}]+\}$|^:[A-Za-z_]\w*$|^<[^>]+>$/.test(segment)
}

export interface ConnectorConfig {
  /** Slack bot token for chat.postMessage (Bearer token) */
  slackBotToken: string
  /** Twilio Account SID for the Messages API URL */
  twilioAccountSid: string
  /** Twilio Auth Token for Basic Auth (password) */
  twilioAuthToken: string
  /** Your Twilio phone number to send the reply from (E.164 format) */
  twilioFromNumber: string
  /** Optional fetch implementation for testing or customization */
  fetch?: typeof fetch
}

export interface TwilioWebhookPayload {
  Body: string
  From: string
  MessageSid: string
}

export interface HandleResult {
  slackMessageTs: string
  twilioMessageSid: string
  routedChannel: 'sales' | 'support'
}

const SALES_KEYWORDS = /pricing|quote|demo/i

function validatePayload(payload: unknown): asserts payload is TwilioWebhookPayload {
  if (!payload || typeof payload !== 'object') {
    throw new Error('Payload must be an object')
  }
  const p = payload as Record<string, unknown>
  if (typeof p.Body !== 'string' || p.Body.trim() === '') {
    throw new Error('Missing required field: Body')
  }
  if (typeof p.From !== 'string' || p.From.trim() === '') {
    throw new Error('Missing required field: From')
  }
  if (typeof p.MessageSid !== 'string' || p.MessageSid.trim() === '') {
    throw new Error('Missing required field: MessageSid')
  }
}

async function postSlackMessage(
  config: ConnectorConfig,
  channel: string,
  text: string
): Promise<string> {
  const fetchImpl = config.fetch ?? fetch
  const url = 'https://slack.com/api/chat.postMessage'
  const body = JSON.stringify({ channel, text })
  const response = await fetchImpl(url, {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: {
      'Authorization': `Bearer ${config.slackBotToken}`,
      'Content-Type': 'application/json'
    },
    body
  })
  if (!response.ok) {
    throw new Error(`Slack API error: ${response.status} ${response.statusText} at ${url}`)
  }
  const data = await response.json() as { ok: boolean; ts: string }
  if (!data.ok) {
    throw new Error(`Slack API returned ok=false at ${url}`)
  }
  return data.ts
}

async function sendTwilioReply(
  config: ConnectorConfig,
  to: string,
  bodyText: string
): Promise<string> {
  const fetchImpl = config.fetch ?? fetch
  const url = `https://api.twilio.com/2010-04-01/Accounts/${config.twilioAccountSid}/Messages.json`
  const params = new URLSearchParams()
  params.append('To', to)
  params.append('From', config.twilioFromNumber)
  params.append('Body', bodyText)
  const auth = btoa(`${config.twilioAccountSid}:${config.twilioAuthToken}`)
  const response = await fetchImpl(url, {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: {
      'Authorization': `Basic ${auth}`,
      'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded'
    },
    body: params.toString()
  })
  if (!response.ok) {
    throw new Error(`Twilio API error: ${response.status} ${response.statusText} at ${url}`)
  }
  const data = await response.json() as { sid: string }
  return data.sid
}

export async function handle(
  payload: TwilioWebhookPayload,
  config: ConnectorConfig
): Promise<HandleResult> {
  validatePayload(payload)

  const isSales = SALES_KEYWORDS.test(payload.Body)
  const channel = isSales ? '#sales' : '#support'
  const routedChannel = isSales ? 'sales' : 'support'

  const slackTs = await postSlackMessage(config, channel, payload.Body)

  const replyBody = 'Thanks for your message! We\'ll get back to you shortly.'
  const twilioSid = await sendTwilioReply(config, payload.From, replyBody)

  return {
    slackMessageTs: slackTs,
    twilioMessageSid: twilioSid,
    routedChannel
  }
}

function btoa(str: string): string {
  if (typeof btoa === 'function' && typeof globalThis !== 'undefined' && 'btoa' in globalThis) {
    return (globalThis as { btoa: (s: string) => string }).btoa(str)
  }
  return Buffer.from(str).toString('base64')
}

# Twilio SMS to Slack Connector

Routes incoming Twilio SMS webhooks to Slack channels based on message content, and sends an automatic SMS reply via Twilio.

## Behavior

- **Sales routing**: Messages containing "pricing", "quote", or "demo" (case-insensitive) → `#sales` channel
- **Support routing**: All other messages → `#support` channel
- **Auto-reply**: Sends "Thanks for your message! We'll get back to you shortly." via Twilio to the sender

## Configuration

Set these environment variables:

| Variable | Description | Required |
|----------|-------------|----------|
| `SLACK_BOT_TOKEN` | Slack bot token with `chat:write` scope (Bearer token) | Yes |
| `TWILIO_ACCOUNT_SID` | Twilio Account SID (used in API URL) | Yes |
| `TWILIO_AUTH_TOKEN` | Twilio Auth Token (Basic auth password) | Yes |
| `TWILIO_FROM_NUMBER` | Your Twilio phone number in E.164 format (e.g., `+15017122661`) | Yes |

## Usage

```typescript
import { handle, ConnectorConfig, TwilioWebhookPayload } from './connector'

const config: ConnectorConfig = {
  slackBotToken: process.env.SLACK_BOT_TOKEN!,
  twilioAccountSid: process.env.TWILIO_ACCOUNT_SID!,
  twilioAuthToken: process.env.TWILIO_AUTH_TOKEN!,
  twilioFromNumber: process.env.TWILIO_FROM_NUMBER!
}

// In your webhook handler (Express, Fastify, etc.):
app.post('/twilio-webhook', async (req, res) => {
  try {
    const payload = req.body as TwilioWebhookPayload
    const result = await handle(payload, config)
    res.json({ success: true, ...result })
  } catch (err) {
    console.error(err)
    res.status(500).json({ success: false, error: err.message })
  }
})
```

## Assumptions

- Twilio webhook payload includes `Body`, `From`, and `MessageSid` fields (application/x-www-form-urlencoded)
- Slack bot token has permission to post to `#sales` and `#support` channels
- The regex `/pricing|quote|demo/i` matches any occurrence in the message body
- Twilio Account SID and Auth Token are valid for sending outbound messages
- The `TWILIO_FROM_NUMBER` is a verified Twilio number capable of sending SMS

## API Calls Made

1. **Slack** `POST https://slack.com/api/chat.postMessage` with Bearer token
   - Body: `{ "channel": "#sales" | "#support", "text": "<SMS body>" }`
2. **Twilio** `POST https://api.twilio.com/2010-04-01/Accounts/{AccountSid}/Messages.json` with Basic auth
   - Form body: `To=<sender>&From=<your Twilio number>&Body=Thanks for your message! We'll get back to you shortly.`

## Response

Returns `{ slackMessageTs, twilioMessageSid, routedChannel }` where `routedChannel` is `"sales"` or `"support"`.

function urlMatches(template: string, actual: string): boolean {
  const t = splitUrl(template)
  const a = splitUrl(actual)
  if (!t || !a) return false
  const tHost = t.host.split('.')
  const aHost = a.host.split('.')
  if (tHost.slice(-2).join('.') !== aHost.slice(-2).join('.')) return false
  const tPath = t.path.replace(/\/+$/, '').split('/')
  const aPath = a.path.replace(/\/+$/, '').split('/')
  if (tPath.length !== aPath.length) return false
  return tPath.every((segment, i) => isPlaceholder(segment) || segment === aPath[i])
}

function splitUrl(url: string): { host: string; path: string } | null {
  const match = url.match(/^https?:\/\/([^/?#]+)([^?#]*)/i)
  return match ? { host: (match[1] ?? '').toLowerCase(), path: match[2] || '/' } : null
}

function isPlaceholder(segment: string): boolean {
  return /^\{[^}]+\}$|^:[A-Za-z_]\w*$|^<[^>]+>$/.test(segment)
}

export interface ConnectorConfig {
  /** HubSpot private app access token. Env: HUBSPOT_ACCESS_TOKEN */
  hubspotAccessToken?: string;
  /** MindCloud Universal API token with Google Sheets scope. Env: MINDCLOUD_API_TOKEN */
  mindcloudApiToken: string;
  /** HubSpot API base URL. Default: https://api.hubapi.com */
  hubspotBaseUrl?: string;
  /** HubSpot engagement search endpoint URL (must support query params email and start_time). Required if hubspotEngagementId is not provided. */
  hubspotSearchUrl?: string;
  /** Optional fixed engagement ID to delete (for testing or when search is not needed). */
  hubspotEngagementId?: string;
  /** Google Sheets spreadsheet ID. */
  googleSheetsSpreadsheetId: string;
  /** Google Sheets worksheet/tab name. */
  googleSheetsWorksheet: string;
  /** Injected fetch implementation (for testing). */
  fetch?: typeof globalThis.fetch;
}

export interface CalendlyWebhookPayload {
  invitee: {
    email: string;
  };
  start_time: string;
  cancellation_reason: string;
}

export interface HandleResult {
  hubspotEngagementDeleted?: string;
  googleSheetsRowAppended?: {
    spreadsheetId: string;
    range: string;
  };
}

type FetchFn = typeof globalThis.fetch;

async function fetchJson<T>(fetch: FetchFn, url: string, init: RequestInit = {}): Promise<T> {
  const response = await fetch(url, init);
  if (!response.ok) {
    throw new Error(`${init.method ?? 'GET'} ${url} failed: ${response.status} ${response.statusText}`);
  }
  if (response.status === 204) {
    return undefined as unknown as T;
  }
  return response.json() as Promise<T>;
}

export async function handle(
  payload: CalendlyWebhookPayload,
  config: ConnectorConfig
): Promise<HandleResult> {
  if (!payload.invitee?.email) {
    throw new Error('Missing required field: invitee.email');
  }
  if (!payload.start_time) {
    throw new Error('Missing required field: start_time');
  }
  if (!payload.cancellation_reason) {
    throw new Error('Missing required field: cancellation_reason');
  }

  const fetch = config.fetch ?? globalThis.fetch;
  if (!fetch) {
    throw new Error('fetch is not available');
  }

  const email = payload.invitee.email;
  const startTime = payload.start_time;
  const cancellationReason = payload.cancellation_reason;

  let engagementId = config.hubspotEngagementId;
  let hubspotDeleted: string | undefined;

  if (config.hubspotAccessToken) {
    if (!engagementId) {
      if (!config.hubspotSearchUrl) {
        throw new Error('HubSpot engagement ID not provided and no search URL configured');
      }
      const searchUrl = new URL(config.hubspotSearchUrl);
      searchUrl.searchParams.set('email', email);
      searchUrl.searchParams.set('start_time', startTime);

      const searchResult = await fetchJson<{ results?: Array<{ id: string }> }>(fetch, searchUrl.toString(), {
        method: 'GET',
        headers: {
          'Authorization': `Bearer ${config.hubspotAccessToken}`,
          'Content-Type': 'application/json',
        },
      });

      if (!searchResult.results?.length) {
        throw new Error(`No HubSpot engagement found for email ${email} and start_time ${startTime}`);
      }
      engagementId = searchResult.results[0].id;
    }

    const hubspotBaseUrl = config.hubspotBaseUrl ?? 'https://api.hubapi.com';
    const deleteUrl = `${hubspotBaseUrl}/crm/v3/objects/engagements/${engagementId}`;

    await fetchJson(fetch, deleteUrl, {
      method: 'DELETE',
      headers: {
        'Authorization': `Bearer ${config.hubspotAccessToken}`,
      },
    });
    hubspotDeleted = engagementId;
  }

  const sheetsUrl = 'https://connect.mindcloud.co/v2/universal/apps/googleSheets/actions/append-rows/run';
  const sheetsBody = {
    arguments: {
      spreadsheetId: config.googleSheetsSpreadsheetId,
      worksheet: config.googleSheetsWorksheet,
      'values[]': [
        {
          col1: email,
          col2: startTime,
          col3: cancellationReason,
        },
      ],
    },
  };

  const sheetsResult = await fetchJson<{
    success: boolean;
    data?: Array<{ spreadsheetId: string; tableRange: string }>;
  }>(fetch, sheetsUrl, {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: {
      'Authorization': `Bearer ${config.mindcloudApiToken}`,
      'Content-Type': 'application/json',
    },
    body: JSON.stringify(sheetsBody),
  });

  if (!sheetsResult.success || !sheetsResult.data?.length) {
    throw new Error('Google Sheets append returned unexpected response');
  }

  return {
    hubspotEngagementDeleted: hubspotDeleted,
    googleSheetsRowAppended: {
      spreadsheetId: sheetsResult.data[0].spreadsheetId,
      range: sheetsResult.data[0].tableRange,
    },
  };
}

# Calendly Meeting Cancelled → HubSpot Engagement Delete + Google Sheets Audit Log

This connector handles the `meeting.cancelled` webhook from Calendly. When a meeting is cancelled, it:
1. Finds the matching HubSpot engagement using the invitee's email and meeting start time as a composite key.
2. Deletes that engagement from HubSpot (moves to recycling bin).
3. Appends an audit row to a Google Sheets spreadsheet with the invitee email, start time, and cancellation reason.

## Configuration

All secrets are supplied via the `ConnectorConfig` object at runtime. The following environment variables are expected:

| Config Property | Environment Variable | Required | Description |
|-----------------|----------------------|----------|-------------|
| `hubspotAccessToken` | `HUBSPOT_ACCESS_TOKEN` | No* | HubSpot private app access token. If omitted, HubSpot deletion is skipped. |
| `mindcloudApiToken` | `MINDCLOUD_API_TOKEN` | Yes | MindCloud Universal API token with Google Sheets scope. |
| `hubspotBaseUrl` | — | No | HubSpot API base URL. Defaults to `https://api.hubapi.com`. |
| `hubspotSearchUrl` | — | Conditional | HubSpot engagement search endpoint URL (must accept `email` and `start_time` query params). Required if `hubspotEngagementId` is not provided. |
| `hubspotEngagementId` | — | No | Fixed engagement ID to delete (for testing or when search is not needed). |
| `googleSheetsSpreadsheetId` | — | Yes | Google Sheets spreadsheet ID. |
| `googleSheetsWorksheet` | — | Yes | Google Sheets worksheet/tab name (e.g., `Audit Log`). |
| `fetch` | — | No | Injected `fetch` implementation (for testing). |

\* `hubspotAccessToken` is required for HubSpot deletion. If not provided, the connector will only append to Google Sheets.

## Usage Example

```typescript
import { handle, ConnectorConfig, CalendlyWebhookPayload } from './connector';

const config: ConnectorConfig = {
  hubspotAccessToken: process.env.HUBSPOT_ACCESS_TOKEN!,
```

const STATUS_TEXT: Record<number, string> = {
  200: 'OK', 201: 'Created', 202: 'Accepted', 204: 'No Content',
  400: 'Bad Request', 401: 'Unauthorized', 403: 'Forbidden', 404: 'Not Found', 409: 'Conflict',
  422: 'Unprocessable Entity', 429: 'Too Many Requests',
  500: 'Internal Server Error', 502: 'Bad Gateway', 503: 'Service Unavailable',
}

/** A JSON Response with the standard status text, e.g. jsonResponse({ error: 'nope' }, 401) -> "401 Unauthorized". */
export function jsonResponse(body: unknown, status = 200): Response {
  const init = { status, statusText: STATUS_TEXT[status] ?? '', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } }
  return new Response(status === 204 ? null : JSON.stringify(body), init)
}

function parseJson(raw: string | undefined): unknown {
  if (raw === undefined) return undefined
  try {
    return JSON.parse(raw)
  } catch {
    return undefined
  }
}

function urlMatches(template: string, actual: string): boolean {
  const t = splitUrl(template)
  const a = splitUrl(actual)
  if (!t || !a) return false
  const tHost = t.host.split('.')
  const aHost = a.host.split('.')
  if (tHost.slice(-2).join('.') !== aHost.slice(-2).join('.')) return false
  const tPath = t.path.replace(/\/+$/, '').split('/')
  const aPath = a.path.replace(/\/+$/, '').split('/')
  if (tPath.length !== aPath.length) return false
  return tPath.every((segment, i) => isPlaceholder(segment) || segment === aPath[i])
}

function splitUrl(url: string): { host: string; path: string } | null {
  const match = url.match(/^https?:\/\/([^/?#]+)([^?#]*)/i)
  return match ? { host: (match[1] ?? '').toLowerCase(), path: match[2] || '/' } : null
}

function isPlaceholder(segment: string): boolean {
  return /^\{[^}]+\}$|^:[A-Za-z_]\w*$|^<[^>]+>$/.test(segment)
}
